scope: Plan checkbox 6 implementation and disposable action verification only

decision.chosen: Persist immutable reviewed requests and reserve a logical intent in a FULL-synchronous SQLite transaction before sending. Atomic source compare-and-consume plus source receipt read-back. An uncertain intent locks the work across request-id changes and process restart.
decision.rejected: Automatic retry with a new request id, terminal keystroke approval, prose-to-approval conversion, or trusting the send ACK as settlement.
decision.recovery: Read the original receipt only. Even a crash between reservation and actual send remains uncertain. No administrative unlock or non-delivery proof protocol is invented.
decision.completion: Receipt completion evidence must match task/spec/attempt and include acceptance criteria/evidence references. Source completion remains claimed_done, never verified completion.
decision.purpose: Preflight compares purpose/spec/session/attempt again after the source read. Previously approved bytes and digests are immutable.

assumptions_and_remaining_risks: Per-work registration is trusted configuration, not source prose. Stable logical work identity and the same durable journal file must survive reconnect/restart.

The structured HTTP adapter implements only the explicitly documented fixture protocol. No live Codex/Claude/Orca/OmO/Senpi/Mail/CRM protocol compatibility was established; all 20 inventory sources remain direct-processing acceptance incomplete.
Uncertain intents deliberately remain blocked without a matching source receipt, including crash-before-send; no unsafe retry/unlock path is provided.
JARVIS approval needs an externally signed Control Plane receipt. Existing execution, lease/fence and completion-verifier boundaries are unchanged.
Action delivery results are reread from the source and displayed separately from collector-owned lifecycle state; this work does not turn a source completion claim into verified task completion.
No production rollout, full live-source acceptance, or checkbox 7 verification is claimed.
